summary: Completed frontend-only testing for Ministry Admin Panel with Microsoft Fluent-inspired UI. All pages load correctly, navigation works, design tokens are properly applied, and form validations function as expected.

design_issues.screen: Create Task Modal / Create User Modal
issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement recommended but not breaking

passed_tests: Login page loads with proper design tokens (blue primary #0078d4, light background #fafafa)
Login with admin credentials (admin@ministry.local / ChangeMe123!)
Dashboard loads with all 7 status stat cards
Dashboard stat cards show correct status colors (Draft-gray, Submitted-blue, Published-green, etc.)
Navigation sidebar renders all menu items (Dashboard, Tasks, Calendar, Activity Log, Settings)
Navigation highlights active page correctly with bg-ministry-bg-tertiary and text-ministry-brand-primary
Tasks page loads with task list, search input, and filter dropdowns
Task search functionality works
Task filter dropdowns (Status, Content Type, Avatar) work correctly
Create Task modal opens and displays all form fields
Create Task form validation works (Title required, Script min 20 chars, Publish date required)
Task creation successful with valid data
Task Details page loads with all tabs (Details, Comments, Activity, Video)
Task Details tabs are clickable and switch content
Task status badge displays correctly
Comments tab shows input and submit button
Video tab shows placeholder upload button (Phase 2)
Calendar page loads with Month/Week view toggle buttons
Calendar Month view displays correct grid layout
Calendar Week view displays current week
Calendar navigation (Today, Previous, Next) works
Calendar highlights current day with blue ring
Activity Log page loads with audit trail table
Activity Log shows 30+ entries with proper columns
Activity Log filter dropdown (Actions) works
Settings page loads with user management table (Admin only)
Settings shows 3 users with Name, Email, Role, Status, Actions columns
Create User modal opens with all form fields
Create User validation works (Name, Email, Password min 8 chars)
Logout functionality works - redirects to login page
User info displays correctly in sidebar (System Admin, Admin role)
critical_code_review_comments: Dialogs missing aria-describedby for accessibility - consider adding DialogDescription component from shadcn/ui
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend features tested and working. Design tokens from ministry.* namespace in tailwind.config.js are properly applied. Status colors match Fluent design spec. Navigation highlighting works correctly. Form validations working. Video upload is a placeholder for Phase 2.
